note: 38 measured regions: 16 exhibit rows (15 figure rows and one table row) and 22 exclusions. The paper prints 19 numbered figures and 3 numbered tables, so 22 exhibits; 16 are measured and 6 are declared gaps rather than given invented bboxes. All six gaps sit on the five pages whose text layer is empty and whose content the layout pass therefore cannot see - p2, p6, p11, p13 and p22 are each a single flat inline raster (1654x2339, A85-encoded BI/ID data) with zero text, zero XObject and zero drawings, so nothing on them can even be sized: p6 prints Table 1 'Notations used in this paper' (Symbol | Description | Unit, six rows in two labelled blocks 'For Model I' and 'For Model II', full grid) and Figure 4 'Abstracting a Quadrilateral into a Rectangle'; p11 prints Table 2 'Parameter Settings' (Parameter | Description | Value | Unit, five or more rows, full grid, the symbol delta_2 printed twice); p13 prints Figure 10 'No fertilizer usage' and Figure 11 'No insecticide usage', each a left line chart plus a right heatmap with its own colour scale; p22 prints Figure 19 'Parameter Perturbation Results', a 7-column by 8-row SSC heatmap with a three-level sensitivity annotation strip. p2 holds no exhibit at all - it is the contents page. The measurable census is therefore 15 of 19 figures and 1 of 3 tables, and the figure numbering 1-19 has no hole in print, only in measurement. Twenty-two regions are excluded: nine 693-path watermark blocks, one wider 708-path footer strip on p26, two ruled appendix text frames on p26 and p27 that are neither charts nor tables, and the nine image regions of the p25 farmer leaflet, which is poster artwork with no printed number. One excluded region is a fragment-of-other: the right panel of Figure 9, under the same single printed number as the measured left panel - the same one-number rule used on #423, #425 and #427, a one-number exhibit is one row plus fragments. Caption positions: every figure caption in this paper is printed BELOW its artwork and the one measurable table caption ABOVE its grid. Text-layer defects recorded as printed: p8 cites the figure as 'Figure 66' although the caption reads Figure 6; p12 cites a bare range '(Figures 9–11)'; p12's own Figure 9 caption ends mid-sentence with 'changes in crop' and resumes on the next line; Table 3's column head prints 'USD/mouth' for 'month'; p17's running text wraps a figure reference as 'Fig- ure 17(B)' on p19; and p21 mixes an italic section head ('7.3 Calculated results') with a bold sans head ('8 Sensitivity Analysis') while printing cross-references in hyperlink blue. The file has 27 sheets but the running folio reads 'Page N of 25', and the five zero-text pages are numbered inside that printed count.
